text: First-class majorEnergy and Power Engineering was selected as one of the national first-class undergraduate majors in 2019. The major has a first-level discipline doctoral degree authorization point of Power engineering and engineering thermophysics (including 6 second-level disciplines and self-set disciplines of clean energy and environmental protection) and post-doctoral mobile station. The first-level discipline of power engineering and engineering thermophysics is the key discipline and the dominant discipline in Jiangsu Province.National Scientific Research PlatformThis major has three national research platforms: International Research Center of Energy Saving Technology for Fluid Engineering Equipment, National 111 Talent Base of Fluid Machinery Equipment and Technology, and National Research Center of Water Pump and System Engineering Technology. Students can conduct research work with the help of national scientific research platform.International Joint Research LaboratoryEnergy and power engineering has established Energy Innovation International Joint Laboratory of China-Thailand, Fluid and Power Engineering International Joint Laboratory of China-South Korea, New Energy Materials International Joint Laboratory of China-Norway and Materials Science Joint Laboratory of China-Denmark.This major has research characteristics in the field of energy and power engineering, and has the ability to undertake international joint and national major projects, and has an important impact in countries along the "the Belt and Road".CURRICULUMMain Courses:Undergraduate program include main professional courses such as ：* Fundamental Control of Energy and Power Engineering* Principles of Fluid Machinery* Experimental Techniques for Fluid Machinery* Numerical Simulation of the Internal Flow in Impeller Pump* Design of Fluid MachineryAll the above courses consist of experimental classes and skills training classesCore Courses:ThermodynamicsEngineering Thermodynamics is a professional basic course for energy and power engineering. Through study of this course, students mainly learn the laws and applications of the mutual conversion between thermal energy and mechanical energy or other energy. Students can scientifically understand and master the basic principles of thermodynamics and energy conversion laws, and master the methods and means of engineering thermodynamics analysis problems, and can apply the knowledge of engineering thermodynamics to the thermal equipment and thermal processes involved in the engineering application of mechanical manufacturing.Measurement Technology of Energy and Power EngineeringMeasurement technology is an important method of promoting technological progress in the field of energy and power engineering. This course aims to train students to master and understand the testing technology commonly used in the field of energy and power engineering. The course focuses on the understanding of the principle and application process of common measuring instruments in energy and power engineering. Through study of this course, students could understand the measurement instruments and methods of sensors, flow velocity, pressure and other key parameters commonly used in the field of energy and power engineering.Cognitive PracticeThe school arranges students to take part in practice and visit various factories to get familiar with the business scope of energy and power engineering, so as to better understand the development prospect of this major and lay a good foundation for future employmenAcademic ResearchOut-of-school experts teach lectures on relative energy and power extreme technologies each year. Students can attend lectures in their spare time to put forward their own opinions on some problems and exchange ideas with teachers. Lectures study and experiments could expand students research ideas and inspire their inspiration.Career DevelopmentEnergy and power engineering is widely used in many industrial fields, such as electric power, automobile, aerospace engineering, and agricultural engineering. Graduates can engage in many aspects of specific work, such as power equipment system design, operation, automatic control, information processing, computer applications, environmental protection, new energy development, energy efficient and clean utilization. Students can use their own professional knowledge to make contribute to the construction of their country.
